# Value Stocks Deep Dive Update

Report 125 | Published 2023-12-10 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2023-12-10/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/125.json)

Value selection amid divergent regional cycles.

Bitcoin appreciation and the global PMI upturn support explicit forecasts; the 2024 value rotation did not materialize. AXP and BTI were strong selections in the observed window, while Cigna lagged heavily. Dividend-adjusted PEG is a useful screening adjustment, but does not make unlike business risks equivalent. The tobacco impairment contained economic information despite being noncash. Swan claims require independent private-company verification, especially given the disclosed director and equity relationship. OMAB and Brazil five-year views remain open.

**Coverage:** Read all blocks 0-145 and 25 image labels. Coverage includes liquidity, yen carry risk, regional demand/production, PMI timing, Bitcoin horizon, Swan conflicts and forecasts, JNJ replacements, factor rotation and all seven named value theses. Published source may contain later edits; same-day Cigna announcement timing is unresolved.

## Framework lessons

- Regulatory moats carry political reset risk.
